# Evaluation (generated from artifacts — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `scripts/write_reports.py` from `artifacts/v2/`. Experiment git revision `8b196ee`, seed 20260928.

## Data and split

* Source: ECMWF IFS ENS (via WeatherBench 2) (`gs://weatherbench2/datasets/ifs_ens/2018-2022-64x32_equiangular_conservative.zarr`); target: Z500 ensemble-mean regional error.
* Reference: ERA5 (WeatherBench 2) - verification reference analysis, not perfect truth.

| Split | Initialisations | First init | Last init | Region×day rows | Bust rate |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|
| train | 1096 | 2018-01-01 00 | 2020-12-29 12 | 698624 | 0.101 |
| validation | 364 | 2021-01-01 00 | 2021-12-28 12 | 230656 | 0.087 |
| test | 366 | 2022-01-01 00 | 2022-12-31 12 | 234240 | 0.088 |
| embargo | 18 | 2020-12-24 00 | 2021-12-31 12 | 6400 | 0.086 |

`embargo` = rows whose verification falls after the end of their period (purged from fitting).

* Run: **v2**; Sentinel learner: standard; validated feature groups in FULL: ATM, EVO, MEM, REC.
* **Test-set history:** 2022 was scored once before, by the v1 pipeline (commit be8123b; Sentinel == B2). All v2 choices (B2 spread/threshold ratio, DYN and tendency features, hyper-parameters, learner, feature groups) were made on the dev split (train 2018-19, validation 2020, dev-test 2021) and locked in this file before v2 scored 2022 once. No v2 decision used 2022 data, but 2022 is a second look, not an untouched test set.

## Headline: does Sentinel beat the calibrated spread-only baseline (B2)?

**Incremental predictive value NOT established** under the rule fixed before the test evaluation (material improvement iff 95% block-bootstrap CI of AUPRC(FULL)-AUPRC(B2) excludes 0 AND relative gain >= 5% (rule fixed before test evaluation)).

* AUPRC FULL 0.143 vs B2 0.143 (test base rate 0.088).
* Difference -0.0007 (-0.5% relative); 95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.0028, 0.0017], 300 resamples of initialisation days; P(diff ≤ 0) = 0.657.

* EXP_RESIDUAL_B2 (EXPERIMENTAL comparison only - not the Sentinel, not promoted): AUPRC gain vs B2 -0.0003 (-0.2% relative), CI [-0.0015, 0.0011].
